title: Quick Snappy Russian Gherkin Skewers
description: A garlicky and energizing Russian dish featuring gherkin relish and lardons-render, perfect for a quick snack, this recipe is Jain-friendly and made with simple ingredients.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Thread a gherkin, a piece of onion, a slice of bell pepper, a cherry tomato, and a sprinkle of parsley onto each skewer.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill the skewers for 5-7 minutes, turning occasionally, until the vegetables are tender.
Meanwhile, heat the lardons-render in a small pan over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic to the pan and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Stir in the gherkin relish and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Serve the skewers hot with the garlicky gherkin relish spooned over the top.
Squeeze a sliver of lemon juice over the skewers and serve immediately.
